nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires every hour. For testing, set to every minute.

nodes.name: HN – Fetch Top Story IDs
nodes.notes: Returns an array of up to 500 story IDs ranked by score.

nodes.name: Transform – Slice Top 5 IDs
nodes.notes: Filters the 500-item list down to the first 5 IDs and shapes them for the next HTTP loop.

nodes.name: HN – Fetch Story Detail
nodes.notes: Second API call – enriches each ID with full story metadata (title, score, URL, author, comment count).

nodes.name: Transform – Aggregate & Sort by Score
nodes.notes: Merges individual story items, filters to type=story, and sorts descending by score.

nodes.name: IF – Top Story Score >= 100
nodes.notes: Routes to 'Hot digest' branch if the top story has 100+ points; otherwise posts a 'quiet day' digest.

nodes.name: Format – Hot Digest
nodes.notes: Builds a Discord embed payload for high-score days (fire emoji, red accent).

nodes.name: Format – Quiet Digest
nodes.notes: Builds a simpler Discord embed for low-score days (newspaper emoji, blue accent).

nodes.name: Discord – Send Hot Digest
nodes.notes: Posts the hot digest embed to the team Discord channel via webhook. URL stored in n8n Credentials.

nodes.name: Discord – Send Quiet Digest
nodes.notes: Posts the quiet-day digest embed to the same Discord channel.

nodes.name: Format – Error Alert
nodes.notes: Formats a Discord error embed whenever any upstream HTTP node fails.

nodes.name: Discord – Send Error Alert
nodes.notes: Posts the error alert to Discord. This node intentionally has no error output — if Discord itself is down, the error is logged in n8n execution history.
